label: Selfie framing
description: How a selfie is taken and framed: where the phone is held, how close, and what of the person and place it shows.
notes: DRAFT. One whole selfie setup per value. Phone position is said by where the hand is, not by lens numbers. 'group' values need more than one person: zero share by default, drawn only when the writer asks for them (where={"kind": "group"}). Closed.
